reasons.plausibility: High-temperature SPS triggering densification and oxide-based passivation is broadly consistent with established sintering and corrosion/oxidation mechanisms, though the exact formation of the proposed oxides under SPS needs more detail.
reasons.testability: Comparing oxidation and corrosion behaviors at different sintering temperatures and checking for the predicted dense oxide film is a clear, feasible test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It proposes a coherent route toward improved properties and outlines specific, measurable outcomes under well-defined conditions, aiding HEA research on Mg-containing systems.
